description: Android Fragment class for displaying and animating a counter with drawable indicators.

classes.name: CounterFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays a counter with animated drawable indicators.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout, initializes drawables and counter text, and starts animation.

methods.name: startAnimation
methods.description: Sets up a TimerTask to toggle drawable indicators periodically.

methods.name: setCounter
methods.description: Sets the counter display text, overloaded for String and int inputs.

methods.name: onDetach
methods.description: Cancels the animation timer when the fragment is detached.
